# 0.6.1 beta 3 — Keep dashboard readings inside their boundaries

- Keep outdoor warning values and units fully visible, including the low
  external temperature in Greek. Let warning labels share the available
  space without cutting off the measurement beside them.
- Allocate outdoor row space according to its content so a short weather
  warning does not take space needed by a longer temperature alert. Keep the
  compact two-row layout without horizontal scrolling.
- Bound long headings, weather descriptions and room-summary labels within
  their containers. Retain the full text in accessible labels and existing
  information views when a compact label needs shortening.

Install the new beta, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the dashboard to
load the updated card. No integration settings are reset. Existing releases,
assets, and tags are retained.
